states: Actual App and Settings renderer consume held, successful, unavailable503 and refused403 synthetic security-status HTTP responses through the normal API client. Playwright1.56.1 matches the integration lock; desktop Chromium141.0.7390.37/light and narrow WebKit26.0/dark.

Closing the existing password dialog triggers a real status refresh without changing credentials. Same-reader checks retain the mounted Authentication panel. A failed check unmounts privileged controls, withdraws restricted navigation and uses the existing General fallback.

The visible unavailable-access callout distinguishes unknown access from authentication-disabled or denied permission. Retry checks status only, disables itself while pending and keeps withdrawn panels and navigation hidden. No raw response error is rendered.

A refused retry submits once without CSRF/auth replay. A fresh successful response with narrower read-only capabilities restores the permitted Authentication view but not credential mutation controls or wider settings access.

35 final interaction and state checks, eight native screenshot inspections, no document-width overflow or uncaught page errors. Both contexts, browsers, Vite and HTTP fixture server closed. Only synthetic GET requests occurred; this is not native administrator or IdP recovery.
Earlier fixture-selector failures and a weaker pass that exposed retry-navigation flicker are retained separately. The final navigation assertion checks the corrected runtime bytes.
interactions: Open and cancel the password dialog, hold the resulting check, and confirm same-reader panel-node preservation after success.
Close it again, return503, inspect the access callout, absence of old principal/control/navigation and usable General fallback.
Retry while held, confirm disabled retry and hidden privileged navigation, then return403 and confirm one read without automatic replay.
Retry with narrower successful capabilities, navigate through desktop/mobile Settings navigation, and inspect read-only Authentication controls.
